Casual.eye_look: Groomed brows, coat of mascara, soft neutral wash
Casual.longevity_tips: Hydrating setting mist, blotted lip tint
application_steps: 1. Skin Prep: Hydrating moisturizer + SPF
2. Concealer: Spot-conceal under eyes and blemishes
3. Tinted Moisturizer / BB Cream: Blend outwards with fingers
4. Cream Blush: Dab on apple of cheeks
5. Brows & Lash: Brush brows with spoolie, 1 coat mascara
6. Lip Tint: Blot tinted balm onto lips

Office.eye_look: Neutral brown shadow, thin brown eyeliner, defined mascara
Office.longevity_tips: Light dusting of translucent powder on T-zone
application_steps: 1. Skin Prep: Lightweight moisturizer + Mattifying Primer on T-zone
2. Foundation: Medium coverage satin foundation blended with sponge
3. Concealer: Brighten under-eye area and blend
4. Powder: Set T-zone with translucent powder
5. Eyes: Sweep neutral taupe/brown shadow, line upper lash line
6. Blush: Soft rose or peach blush on cheekbones
7. Lips: Long-wear satin lipstick in nude or rose

Party.eye_look: Smokey eye or metallic shimmer shadow, winged gel eyeliner
Party.longevity_tips: Pore-filling primer + setting spray before and after
application_steps: 1. Skin Prep: Hydrating sheet mask + Illuminating primer
2. Foundation: Full coverage long-wear foundation
3. Concealer: Highlight center of face and conceal spots
4. Contour & Blush: Sculpt cheekbones with contour, sweep vibrant blush
5. Eyes: Layer eyeshadow base, shimmer lid, winged eyeliner, volumizing mascara
6. Highlighter: Dab on cheekbones, Cupid's bow, inner corners
7. Lips: Bold lip liner + long-lasting liquid lipstick
8. Setting Spray: Lock look with 3-4 sprays

Wedding.eye_look: Gold/Bronze metallic shimmer, false lashes or heavy mascara, smoked liner
Wedding.longevity_tips: Waterproof formulas + dual setting spray locking
application_steps: 1. Skin Prep: Deep hydrating serum + Long-wear grip primer
2. Color Correction: Neutralize dark circles with peach/orange corrector
3. Foundation: Flashback-free HD foundation blended smoothly
4. Conceal & Bake: Conceal under eyes and lightly bake T-zone
5. Bronzer & Blush: Rich bronzer for warm glow, blush on high points
6. Eyes: Gold/rose gold eyeshadow, waterproof eyeliner, curled lashes
7. Lips: Hydrating lip liner + festive red or berry lipstick
8. Setting Spray: Matte long-wear setting mist

College.eye_look: Clear brow gel, mascara, subtle nude liner
application_steps: 1. Skin Prep: Moisturizer + SPF 50
2. Concealer: Dab on blemishes and under eyes
3. Tinted Lip Balm: Use on both lips and cheeks as cream blush
4. Mascara: 1 light coat

Festival.eye_look: Pop of color or bronze shimmer, graphic eyeliner
application_steps: 1. Skin Prep: Hydrating primer with SPF
2. Foundation: Dewy cushion or fluid foundation
3. Blush: Bright coral or berry blush
4. Eye Sparkle: Shimmer shadow or colorful eyeliner
5. Glossy Lips: Vibrant lip gloss or stain
